'''Kthira'shi'ktarloo''', better known by [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Core name/Legends|core name]], '''Ashik''', was a male [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] who served as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] and an [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to [[Jagged Fel]], the [[Head of State (Imperial Remnant)|Head of State]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. After a [[Kidnap attempt in the Galactic Empire Embassy Complex|kidnap attempt]] on Fel, Ashik, along with a number of [[Imperial Security (Imperial Remnant)|Imperial Security]] guards, was the first to arrive at Fel's [[Galactic Empire Embassy|embassy]] quarters.<ref name="backlash" /> He later assisted Fel in a [[Battle over Exodo II|space battle]] against Imperial defectors in [[44 ABY]].<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>
